items.title: Signature-invalidity control
items.context: A JWT for a disposable test identity
items.intended_use: Confirm the service rejects a tampered token before trusting claims
items.payload: Change one harmless payload claim without changing the signature
caveats: Do not impersonate users or place full compact tokens in evidence
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.

items.title: Unsecured-token review marker
items.context: A designated test token and harmless identity endpoint
items.intended_use: Confirm explicit rejection of unsecured JWTs
items.payload: REVIEW-ONLY: alg none with a synthetic test identity
caveats: Never use real-user claims or tokens
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.

items.title: Wrong-audience control
items.context: Two owner-approved test audiences and synthetic keys/tokens
items.intended_use: Verify the target service rejects a valid token intended elsewhere
items.payload: Set aud to a different owner-controlled test service, then sign with its valid test issuer
caveats: Do not forge production signatures or retain signing material
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.
